alternative_explanations: Raw nonlinear geometry may already make nearest-neighbour exact, so any learned index gain may be ordinary locality-sensitive hashing rather than learned semantic routing.
The finite synthetic renderer may make change-point splitting or entity matching easier than open-world learned addressing even without explicit identifiers.
confounds: This is one locally visible synthetic family and one runner-random seed; even a positive result cannot establish open-world routing, cross-family transfer, general intelligence or an LLM successor.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if an implementable role receives entity IDs, ready keys, latent coordinates, family/class labels, paths, scoring targets or privileged routing.
Invalidate if encoder fitting sees runner-random test queries or outcomes, or if any constant changes after scoring output.

Invalidate unless the four causal roles share encoder source, architecture, initialization, data order, outputs, verifier, update, constants and accounting outside the registered representation/access intervention.
Invalidate if fallback examines more than 32 records or grows with K, if local insertion triggers global encoder refit, or if encoder/routing/index/verifier/fallback cost or bytes are omitted.
Invalidate on pretrained weights, model API, network use, state-budget breach, seed leakage, missing mandatory control, preflight mismatch or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard the exact rule if learned-address accuracy is more than 0.02 below dense scan, fails to exceed either frozen or shuffled representation, fails confusable held-out views or local insertion, has K-cost slope at least 0.30, scans more than 32 fallback records, globally refits on insertion, breaches state or is Pareto-dominated by raw nearest-neighbour or dense GRU at matched quality.

Invalidate on role-source or constant mismatch, entity/key/latent/scoring leakage, scoring-seed access during fit, post-score tuning, missing mandatory control, external model/API/network use, preflight mismatch or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: Discard this exact encoder/key/probe/verifier/fallback rule without tuning and record which matched-quality or full-cost gate strengthened HYP-0012, without claiming general impossibility.
outcome_policy.null: Treat the mechanism as inconclusive only if a technically complete result lies within preregistered uncertainty yet does not satisfy the full conjunction; do not tune it in this cohort.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep only the unchanged learned-address rule for a three-seed adversarial or disjoint-corpus screen; do not mark promising or promote.

predicted_outcome: The learned address will remain within 0.02 accuracy of source-identical dense scan, exceed frozen and shuffled representations, keep bounded fallback and local insertion, and show full three-point K-cost slope below 0.30 after charging encoding, fit, routing, verifier, fallback, bytes and R1/R4/R16/R256/R4096.
promotion_criteria: No promotion is permitted from this one-seed quick; a complete positive conjunction may only authorize an unchanged three-seed adversarial or disjoint-corpus screen.
research_question: Can one locally learned encoder create a discrete verifiable address that preserves dense-scan quality while total access cost grows sublinearly over a 100-fold increase in confusable knowledge and new records are inserted without global retraining?
title: Learned discrete addressing from raw nonlinear observations
